messages.author: Kriti Shukla
messages.body:
Hello everyone,

a hitch; however, during the test (serial), even though every test passed,
I encountered an error similar to this.
......
Finished serial test suite for Amber 18 at Thu May 30 12:28:46 IST 2024.
make[2]: Leaving directory `/home/srabanicy/amber18/test'
163 file comparisons passed
0 file comparisons failed (0 ignored)
0 tests experienced errors
Test log file saved as
/home/srabanicy/amber18/logs/test_amber_serial/2024-05-30_12-23-55.log
No test diffs to save!
make[1]: Leaving directory `/home/srabanicy/amber18/test'
Summary of AmberTools serial tests:
cat: ../logs/test_at_serial/at_summary: No such file or directory

..........
Should I keep going, or should I fix it?Furthermore, how?
Regards
--
Kriti Shukla
Research Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur
India. 721302

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:

>In my attempt to install AMBER-18 on our server, every process went without

>163 file comparisons passed

>/home/srabanicy/amber18/logs/test_amber_serial/2024-05-30_12-23-55.log
>No test diffs to save!

>
>Summary of AmberTools serial tests:
>
>cat: ../logs/test_at_serial/at_summary: No such file or directory
>make: *** [test.serial] Error 1
This was just going to re-print a summary of the AmberTools tests.  I'm not
sure why that file is not present -- did the AmberTools tests go smoothly?
By itself, this is nothing to worry about.  But I would recommend upgrading
to Amber24, which has six years worth of improvements and bug-fixes.
...dac
